description: Source code for a minidump generator handling crash dump creation on Solaris, including thread and stack analysis, context writing, and minidump file structure setup.

classes.name: WriterArgument
classes.description: Holds parameters for the dump writing process, including minidump writer, thread info, crash context, and signal info.

classes.name: FindCrashLwpContext
classes.description: Context for identifying the crashing lightweight process (lwp) based on stack bottom comparison.

classes.name: LwpInfoCallbackCtx
classes.description: Callback context for collecting thread info during minidump creation.

classes.name: AutoLwpResumer
classes.description: RAII class to control LWP execution state during dump writing.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Main function to generate the minidump, called in a separate thread, writes various streams into the dump file.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpToFile
methods.description: Public method to initiate minidump creation for a given file path, crash signal, and context.
